note: Untitled doc §13–16 (Phase E). Difficulty presets, optional modifiers, Death-Block and game modes. A modifier or mode with status "planned" is listed but cannot be picked.

difficulties.name: Story
difficulties.blurb: Gentler enemies. For enjoying the campaign.

difficulties.name: Nightmare
difficulties.blurb: For the end of the road.

deathBlock.rule: If your whole party faints in your first 5 battles, you go back to the start of the stage with your party healed. Works once per run.

modifiers.name: No Transformations
modifiers.blurb: Mega, Tera, Z-Moves and Dynamax are off for both sides.

modifiers.name: Scarce Supplies
modifiers.blurb: You start with half the money and half the items.

modifiers.name: Monotype
modifiers.blurb: Every Pokémon you keep must share a type with your starter.

modifiers.name: Single Region Dex
modifiers.blurb: Wild and trainer Pokémon come only from one randomly chosen generation.

modifiers.name: Rich Route
modifiers.blurb: 25% more money from battles, but every enemy is 2 levels higher.

modifiers.name: Blind Research
modifiers.blurb: The map hides each stage's theme until you arrive. Research Points x1.5.

modifiers.name: No Revives
modifiers.blurb: Revive items never appear in rewards or shops.

modifiers.name: Random Draft
modifiers.blurb: Your draft rule is picked at random (from the ones with no license).

modifiers.name: Boss Rush
modifiers.blurb: A shorter campaign: 4 stages per region, so gyms and leagues come twice as often.

modifiers.name: Variant Hunt
modifiers.blurb: Event stops are 50% more common. Ordinary forms are unchanged and shiny odds do not change.

modifiers.name: Limited Party
modifiers.blurb: Your party holds at most 4 Pokémon.

modifiers.name: No Duplicate Species
modifiers.blurb: Only one Pokémon of each evolution line in your party.

modes.name: Standard
modes.blurb: The roguelike. A wipe ends the run.

modes.name: Adventure
modes.blurb: No restart on a wipe: you go back to the start of the stage. No Bank Credits, Research Points, candies, unlocks or achievements.
